answer: Seniority ramp: an identity's reward weight starts at 0.2 and rises 0.08 per epoch, reaching 1.0 at epoch 10. A Sable cluster of k fresh identities earns 0.2k, not k, and needs ten epochs to reach the Summit weight, so splitting one operator into 50 accounts yields 10 effective accounts, a 5x haircut. Bypass: a patient adversary pre-ages dormant accounts, paying only idle epochs. Check rule: any auditor recomputes weights from first-seen epochs on the public Wharf ledger and rejects payouts above weight times base reward.
